## Execution
Use the verified round-5 skill, which maximizes (1 + normalized savings) times a quadratic fill bonus times a radial bonus.

**Why:** Mean distance 11.06980 versus 12.11504, improving all six training instances.

**How to apply:** Preserve the actual product as the reference and change one factor at a time if refining.

**Reusable Experience:** The winner departed from the Plan's near-tie constraint. Candidate code and training scores are the evidence.
